statement: Let e1, e2 be the coordinate unit vectors and set bj(x) = σxσx+ej − 1/ √ 2. In the full-plane critical law, Cov0(bj(0), bk(x)) = 1 + o(1) π2|x|2 , |x| −→ ∞, j, k ∈ {1, 2}. (2.7) For a fixed finite local average B(x) = ∑ q cqbjq (x + dq), with cq ≥ 0 and c = ∑ q cq > 0, Cov0(B(0), bk(x)) ∼ c π2|x|2 , Cov0(B(0), B(x)) ∼ c2 π2|x|2 . In particular square symmetrization of the bond energy cannot cancel its leading covariance.
